baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative سَبِّحْ, the construction بِاسْمِ, and the linked titles رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command joins active clearing of false attribution to a raised designation, then locates that designation in rightful lordship and greatness.

activation_trace.role: Clearing and declaring free supplies the imperative act of removing deficient attribution.
Name as raised designation makes the name the explicit verbal site of that clearing.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify whose designation has rightful claim.
Greatness and strength supply the positive magnitude acknowledged after false attribution is cleared.

changed_reading.before: Offer a general formula of praise to the great Lord.
changed_reading.after: Actively clear the Lord's raised designation of false attribution and acknowledge the authority to which greatness properly belongs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative form of سَبِّحْ and the relational phrase رَبِّكَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tasbih can be enacted worship, while rabb can name stage-by-stage nurture and completion; the command therefore couples voiced praise with practiced devotion under formative care.

activation_trace.role: Worship through praise and prayer expands the imperative from a statement into devotional performance.
Raised designation gives the enacted worship a named relation rather than an anonymous sacred object.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship an ongoing formative action addressed by devotion.
Greatness and strength characterize the nurturing authority enacted toward.

changed_reading.after: Enter a named practice of praise and worship toward the Lord whose great care repairs and brings to completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus word اسْم is mapped not only to س م و but also to the non-dominant و س م inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The name can be carried as an identifying sign whose visible trace distinguishes rightful lordship; tasbih then makes that sign legible by clearing misidentification.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies an exploratory sign-function for the focus name.
A sign read by discerning observation makes the designation something whose implications can be recognized.
Purifying and declaring free functions as the removal of misleading marks or attributions.
Lordship and authority are what the clarified sign identifies.

changed_reading.before: The name is simply the lexical object accompanying praise.
changed_reading.after: The name also works as a legible identifying sign: tasbih clears it so rightful lordship can be recognized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening and penultimate truth-language frames the focus imperative, turning purification of the name into alignment of speech with fixed reality rather than ornamental acclaim.

activation_trace.role: Fixity matching reality establishes the opening pole of the frame and the standard for truthful praise.
The same reality-matching fixity immediately before the focus converts the closing imperative into a response to established truth.
Clearing false attribution becomes the speech-act that conforms to the truth frame.
Name as raised designation locates truth-alignment in how the Lord is designated.

structural_cues: The ح ق ق root recurs in 69:1-3 and returns in 69:51 immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reality-fixity around the surah and a final imperative; I infer that the imperative verbalizes alignment with that reality. A live alternative is a conventional concluding act of veneration without a bookend mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The final command closes with generic praise.
changed_reading.after: The final command is the reader's speech-level alignment with the fixed reality announced at the opening and reaffirmed just before it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overflowing force is driven to a purpose, made exhaustively uprooting, and finally levels the supposedly stable terrain; greatness is activated as authority that directs and terminates runaway force, not mere superior size.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing water and sweeping force supply the uncontrolled-looking energy that must be accounted for.
Subjection and driving toward a purpose turn destructive force into directed instrumentality.
Uprooting completion supplies the force's assigned endpoint rather than indefinite excess.
Pounding and demolition to level ground show even massive supports reaching a controlled terminus.
Lordship and authority provide the focus anchor for directing force to its end.
Greatness and strength become governing capacity rather than a comparative measurement.

structural_cues: The destruction sequence repeatedly pairs excess or massive structures with verbs of subjection, exhaustion, and leveling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sweeping force, purposeful subjection, uprooting sequence, and leveling; I supply the arrow from those operations to a governing account of العظيم. The alternative is that the sequence demonstrates raw power without distinguishing direction from magnitude.

changed_reading.before: Great means larger or stronger than every destructive thing.
changed_reading.after: Great names the Lord's capacity to govern the course and endpoint of forces that appear to exceed every boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The overhead sky, sharing the focus's س م و root, is split and weakened; the focus reactivates that root as name/designation and attaches greatness to the Lord. Tasbih therefore clears greatness of equation with spatial height or an overhead container.

activation_trace.role: Splitting and opening break the apparent integrity of the elevated cosmic cover.
The overhead sky and cover provide the spatially elevated object that fails.
Slackening weakness makes the failure of spatial height explicit.
Name as raised designation reuses the root in a non-spatial register after the sky's failure.
Declaring free supplies the operation that removes spatial analogy from the designation.
Greatness and strength remain with the Lord when the elevated created cover becomes weak.

structural_cues: One ayah makes the س م و-derived sky both split and weak; the focus later uses the same QAC root for اسْم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same-root switch from failing sky to name and the focus predicate العظيم; I infer a contrast that de-spatializes greatness. The alternative is ordinary homonymy with no intended contrast between sky and name.

changed_reading.before: The Great Lord is imagined through maximal height and cosmic scale.
changed_reading.after: Glorifying the Great Lord explicitly breaks the analogy with height: the sky can split and weaken, while divine greatness is carried by the purified designation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated carrying scales from rescued people to earth and mountains to the throne, while the throne branch can name the standing order of an affair. Rabb al-azim is activated as the authority under which carriers, loads, and order itself are reassigned.

activation_trace.role: Lifting a visible load begins the carrying sequence with preserved people as the carried object.
The same visible carrying image scales the load up to earth and mountains.
A third visible carrying transfers attention from displaced creation to the borne throne.
The standing or collapse of an affair supplies an order-bearing dimension to the throne image.
Superiority by mastery distinguishes ruling order from the creatures that physically carry.
Repair, administration, and completion anchor the carrying sequence in formative lordship.
Greatness and strength become the capacity under which the order of loads is reconstituted.

structural_cues: ح م ل recurs at 69:11, 69:14, and 69:17 with successively altered subjects and loads.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the carrying recurrence, the throne's order-image, and mastery above; I infer a load-bearing model of lordship that coordinates them. A live alternative treats each carrying event locally without a shared mechanics of order.

changed_reading.before: Lordship is an honorific title attached to greatness.
changed_reading.after: Lordship is the ordering capacity under which who carries, what is carried, and what remains structurally authoritative can all be reassigned.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exposure removes concealment, the book fixes an obligating record, reading voices it, and account enumerates it. Against that sequence, praise by the name becomes accountable public designation rather than untested private acclaim.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something out for inspection supplies the public exposure in which designation is tested.
Removal of hiddenness closes the gap between inward attribution and exposed reality.
A written fixing that obligates judgment gives exposed conduct a durable record.
Reading and recitation turn the fixed record into voiced testimony before others.
Counting and accounting supply the criterion against which voiced designation is answerable.
Name as raised designation makes the focus utterance part of the public field of attribution.
Purifying attribution becomes a discipline answerable to exposure and record.

structural_cues: 69:18 moves directly from total exposure into paired book-and-account scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, record, recitation, and account; I infer that the focus's name-bearing speech is calibrated by this public audit. The alternative is that the judgment scene concerns deeds while the closing tasbih remains purely devotional speech.

changed_reading.before: Praise is valid by the sincerity or beauty of the utterance alone.
changed_reading.after: Praise by the name is accountable speech whose attribution must survive exposure, record, recitation, and reckoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned failure is not only lack of provision but failure to urge it for the socially abased person. This activates the nurturing branch of rabb so that worship of the Great Lord cannot remain detached from circulating sustenance and exhortation.

activation_trace.role: Urging toward an act makes social transmission of care, not only private giving, part of the mechanism.
Feeding another supplies the concrete provision that exhortation is meant to circulate.
Abasement and deprivation identify the vulnerable recipient around whom the social failure is exposed.
Nurture, repair, and completion make provision a concrete analogue of the lordship being praised.
Worship through praise and prayer is revised into devotion that cannot ignore the packet's named social failure.
Greatness and strength contrast with status systems that leave the deprived person abased.

structural_cues: 69:33-34 pairs refusal of faith in the Great God with refusal to urge feeding the deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the paired indictment and the branches of urging, feeding, abasement, and nurture; I infer that praise of nurturing lordship has a social entailment. The alternative is that the two indictments remain parallel failures without one specifying the practice of the other.

changed_reading.before: Glorification is a vertical act between worshipper and Lord.
changed_reading.after: Glorification of the nurturing Great Lord is contradicted when the worshipper will not even mobilize provision for the socially abased.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse distinguishes delivered speech from invented attribution and places fabricated sayings beside severance of the life-artery with no intervening barrier. The focus command therefore disciplines naming: glorification must preserve the received designation rather than manufacture sacred speech.

activation_trace.role: Saying what did not exist or falsely ascribing it defines the counterfeit speech against which naming is guarded.
Putting something in its proper station gives delivered discourse an authorized placement before the fabrication test.
Severing and separation supply the irreversible sanction attached to counterfeit attribution.
The life-artery makes the sanction target the bodily condition of continued speech itself.
Interposition by a separating barrier is denied, closing off rescue for fabricated attribution.
Name as raised designation makes the focus command an act of attribution subject to the speech test.
Clearing false attribution becomes fidelity to authorized designation, not license to embellish it.

structural_cues: 69:40-47 tests the discourse against poetry, divination, and fabricated sayings before the closing commands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized descent, false ascription, bodily severance, and failed interposition; I infer a speech ethic governing the focus name. The alternative is that the sanction authenticates only the messenger and does not generalize to the reader's glorifying speech.

changed_reading.before: Any amplifying sacred language can serve glorification if its intention is reverent.
changed_reading.after: Glorification is constrained attribution: the Lord's name is to be cleared and faithfully voiced, not enlarged through invented sacred speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence moves through reminder and self-protection, then places uncovering/regret against covering, and ends in stabilized knowledge. Tasbih becomes the terminal anti-covering practice: retain the reminder, clear the designation, and voice certainty before concealment is stripped away as loss.

activation_trace.role: A reminder that makes one remember supplies the retained content carried into the final imperative.
Placing oneself within protection makes reception of the reminder an active guarded posture.
Uncovering and removal of a screen supply the reversal by which concealed reality becomes exposed.
Covering supplies the opposed posture that the reminder and final clearing answer.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed gives the final tasbih its epistemic ground.
Purifying and declaring free perform the anti-covering response required by the sequence.
The raised designation is the specific content cleared of concealment and doubt.

structural_cues: 69:48-52 forms an uninterrupted close: reminder, protected recipients, deniers, exposure/regret, certainty, then imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, protection, uncovering, covering, certainty, and purification; I infer a directional sequence from retained warning through de-covering to voiced certainty. The alternative is that these are adjacent conclusions without a single anti-covering mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Tasbih follows certainty as a separate devotional coda.
changed_reading.after: Tasbih completes the reminder's work by countering concealment now, before the cover is removed only as irreversible exposure and loss.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the physical coursing branch of س ب ح inside a liturgical imperative. It remains anchored in the focus verb and is sharpened by the packet's flowing vessel image, but downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic undertone, never translate سَبِّحْ literally as swim here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus imperative سَبِّحْ has a packet branch of swimming or coursing motion.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or coursing gives the imperative an exploratory image of sustained motion through a medium.
Flowing and gliding supplies a context medium in which preservation itself occurs through motion.

changed_reading.before: The imperative is a static utterance after the narrative has ended.
changed_reading.after: The imperative carries a kinetic undertone: keep praise moving through the destabilized world as the vessel moved through overflow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the concrete pack-saddle-frame branch of ع ظ م. It remains anchored in الْعَظِيمِ and gains a mechanism from the repeated carrying and order-bearing throne, but it should appear only as a structural metaphor for load-bearing capacity, never as a lexical gloss of the adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus adjective الْعَظِيمِ has a packet branch naming a bare wooden pack-saddle frame.

activation_trace.role: The bare load-frame supplies the odd but concrete image of strength organized to bear weight.
Visible carrying gives the frame image a live load-bearing function in context.
The standing order of an affair converts physical load-bearing into a metaphor for structural authority.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, greatness can suggest a frame-like capacity that bears and orders weight without being identical to the carriers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant split mapping of the focus root and a remote branch of intended direction. It remains anchored in اسْم and coheres with the context's faced direction, but downstream prose must mark it as associative orientation, not replace the ordinary meaning name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus اسْم is mapped to a non-dominant س م م target whose B011 branch concerns intended direction.

activation_trace.role: Intended direction and probed depth supply an exploratory orienting function for the name construction.
A direction faced in worship gives the inferred orientation a concrete context analogue.
Worship through praise makes directed orientation functionally relevant to the imperative.

changed_reading.before: By the name identifies only what is uttered.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, by the name also orients the worship-act toward its intended Lord and away from rival directions.

strongest_changes: The opening/closing ح ق ق frame turns the imperative into truthful designation rather than ornamental praise.
The cracked and weakened sky de-spatializes الْعَظِيمِ: created height fails while the Lord's purified designation remains.
Exposure, record, recitation, account, and the fabrication test make name-bearing praise publicly accountable speech.
The failure to urge feeding activates nurturing lordship as a social demand inside devotional glorification.
The final reminder-protection-covering-certainty sequence makes tasbih an anti-concealment response before irreversible exposure.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive feature was the same-root switch from سَمَاء as a failing overhead cover to اسْم as raised designation, joined by repeated carrying and a closing cover/uncover sequence. Split mappings also preserved sign, frame, and directional readings without forcing them into the main translation.
remaining_uncertainties: The sky/name contrast may be a reader-constructed same-root resonance rather than an intended lexical linkage.
The social entailment from nurturing lordship is strongly activated by juxtaposition but is still an inferred arrow.
The coursing, load-frame, and directional-name outliers are cross-domain analogies and must not be rendered as lexical replacements.
